sentence: This project builds mathematical models that show how species with different traits respond to habitat fragmentation.
This project studies how communities of cave-adapted arthropods form and keep their diversity in lava tubes.
This project uses the mathematical study of symmetry to find patterns and formulas in complicated data.
This project builds cybersecurity skills through hands-on activities outside the classroom, such as defending a network against attack.
This project builds a method that separates complex glycosylated protein samples using ligands that assemble into a template.
This project builds a hands-on curriculum and learning platform that teaches how to find and reduce security risks in agentic AI systems.
This project teaches drone assembly, sensor integration and autonomous flight programming through hands-on learning.
This project develops safe, biodegradable ultraviolet filters made from components already present in the human body for use in sunscreens.
This project studies how robots can understand what people say and explain their actions so they can work as trusted teammates.
This project studies how bats adapt to white-nose syndrome and builds a computer model that forecasts how the disease spreads.
This project teaches hands-on robotics and AI through clubs and university-level coursework.
This project combines AI with optimization to tackle hard problems in energy systems, supply chains and semiconductor manufacturing.
This project builds methods that let anyone with a smartphone capture video and turn it into a moving three-dimensional virtual reality scene.
This project studies how attacks sent through communication systems can disrupt the electric grid and looks for ways to protect it.
This project builds privacy protection directly into the memory of electronic devices instead of relying on software.
This project measures the water cycle in Greenland permafrost watersheds to find out where Arctic river water comes from and how that is changing.
This project measures how deep the ground above permafrost thaws each year at sites in northern Alaska and tracks how that changes over time.
This project builds a computer system that uses deep learning to forecast floods in near real-time.
